description: This file implements a work queue system (p4wq) for Zephyr RTOS, including thread management, priority setting, and scheduling logic.

methods.name: set_prio
methods.description: Sets thread priority and deadline based on work item.

methods.name: rb_lessthan
methods.description: Comparison function for red-black tree nodes based on priority and deadline.

methods.name: thread_clear_requeued
methods.description: Clears the requeued status of a thread.

methods.name: thread_was_requeued
methods.description: Checks if a thread was requeued.

methods.name: item_lessthan
methods.description: Comparison for work items based on priority and deadline.

methods.name: p4wq_loop
methods.description: Main loop for processing work items in the queue.

methods.name: k_p4wq_wait
methods.description: Waits for a work item to complete.

methods.name: k_p4wq_add_thread
methods.description: Adds a thread to the work queue.

methods.name: static_init
methods.description: Static initialization of work queues at system startup.

methods.name: k_p4wq_enable_static_thread
methods.description: Enables a static thread with specified CPU affinity.

methods.name: k_p4wq_submit
methods.description: Submits a work item to the queue, possibly preempting threads.

methods.name: k_p4wq_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a work item if it is in the queue.
